Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Butler
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 29 as introduced would reduce the obligations of the Election Expenses Account, funded by State General Fund appropriations, by an estimated $888,000 every four years by no longer mailing notices to all registered voters.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Rafferty
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/18/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 56 as introduced provides for the continuance of the State Board of Podiatry until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or federal funding.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions
